{
  "candidate_rtl": "module pw_crc32_d8 (
    input  wire [7:0]  data_in,
    input  wire [31:0] state_in,
    output wire [7:0]  data_out,
    output wire [31:0] state_out
);

    // Combine corresponding data and state bits before the CRC network.
    wire [7:0] q;
    assign q = data_in ^ state_in[7:0];

    // Constant linear-transform masks for eight reflected CRC32 steps.
    // Indices 0..31 select next-state bits; 32..39 select shifted-out bits.
    function [7:0] crc_mask;
        input integer index;
        reg [31:0] c;
        reg [7:0] d;
        integer j;
        integer k;
        begin
            crc_mask = 8'b0;
            for (j = 0; j < 8; j = j + 1) begin
                c = 32'b1 << j;
                d = 8'b0;
                for (k = 0; k < 8; k = k + 1) begin
                    d[k] = c[0];
                    c = (c >> 1) ^ (32'hedb88320 & {32{c[0]}});
                end
                if (index < 32)
                    crc_mask[j] = c[index];
                else
                    crc_mask[j] = d[index-32];
            end
        end
    endfunction

    genvar n;
    generate
        for (n = 0; n < 32; n = n + 1) begin : state_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(n);
            wire lo;
            wire hi;
            assign lo = ^(q[3:0] & MASK[3:0]);
            assign hi = ^(q[7:4] & MASK[7:4]);
            if (n < 24) begin : shifted_state
                assign state_out[n] = (lo ^ hi) ^ state_in[n+8];
            end else begin : feedback_only
                assign state_out[n] = lo ^ hi;
            end
        end
        for (n = 0; n < 8; n = n + 1) begin : data_bits
            localparam [7:0] MASK = crc_mask(n+32);
            assign data_out[n] = ^(q & MASK);
        end
    endgenerate
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline maps wide CRC parity expressions into reconvergent logic with substantial low-state-bit fanout. Reported critical paths include input buffering followed by several NAND/complex-gate stages and a final parity operation.",
  "rewrite": "Factor data_in[i] XOR state_in[i] into eight shared signals before applying the reflected CRC32 transform. Generate constant masks at elaboration and express state parity as two four-bit reductions. Preserve the shifted upper-state contribution separately. Compute data_out from the same exact eight-step transform rather than treating it as pass-through data.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce duplicated parity work and input loading, with a plausible improvement over the 0.97 ns baseline. No numerical gain is verified; the fixed synthesis, mapping, STA, and electrical-check flow must establish the actual result.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Eight shared input XORs replace repeated data/state contributions across output equations. Area should generally decrease, although shared-signal buffering and mapping choices affect the result. Compliance with the 2719.608320 um2 cap has not been measured.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Complete combinational implementation of the fixed, parameterless pw_crc32_d8 interface. Implements reflected polynomial 32'hedb88320, equivalent to the reference's reversed 32'h04c11db7 Galois configuration. Both outputs retain dependence on arbitrary state_in and data_in; there is no initialization, final inversion, state, latency, assumption, or undefined output. Functions and loops generate constant masks and require no memories or helper modules. Source and mapped equivalence remain to be checked by the evaluation flow."
}
